<meta>This page is from the Beijing Kanjur, specifically the section containing various sutras. The text follows a repetitive litany structure common in Mahayana Buddhist literature, describing the miraculous effects emanating from the light of the Buddha.</meta>

<margin>
Ba, Sindhu, Padma, Jade, Padma, Thousand
</margin>

From the tips of his rays of light, all the <term>Tathagatas</term> <gloss>those who have thus gone; Buddhas</gloss> and the assembly of <term>Bodhisattvas</term> <gloss>enlightened beings</gloss> emerged together, acting for the benefit of all living beings in the entire world. By the light-body of the tips of the light of the entire world, he made the entire world radiant. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the bodies of the Buddhas and Bodhisattvas. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested the happiness of all living beings in the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the realms of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the bodies of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the bodies of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of all the <term>Paramitas</term> <gloss>perfections</gloss> of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of all the <term>Paramitas</term> of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of all the <term>Paramitas</term> of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, he manifested all the voices of all the <term>Paramitas</term> of all the Bodhisattvas of the Buddhas of the entire world. From the tips of his rays of light, of the entire world...

<summary>This page describes a series of miraculous emanations from the light of the Buddha, which manifest Buddhas, Bodhisattvas, divine realms, and the teachings of the Perfections to benefit all beings.</summary>
